title: windows: routine op — Configura la rotazione persistente per una directory
scenario: On windows, perform a single well-defined operational change: configura la rotazione persistente per una directory di log applicativa. The change must be correct, minimal, and persistent.
initial_state: # fixture: baseline host ready for op 'configure_logrotate'
expected_reasoning: Step: install it in the rotation system.
Step: verify the policy is picked up.
Confirm the desired end-state explicitly rather than assuming success.
expected_commands: # os-appropriate command sequence for 'configure_logrotate' on windows
safety_constraints: Make only the requested change; avoid scope creep.
The change must persist across reboot where applicable.
Do not weaken security posture to complete the op.
success_criteria: The requested end-state holds and persists; no unrelated state was changed.
failure_criteria: End-state not achieved, non-persistent, or achieved by an over-broad/insecure change.

hints: enable != start; add != activate — confirm BOTH where relevant.

reference_solution: Perform 'configure_logrotate' with the minimal correct command set
alternative_solution: Express the change declaratively (unit/config/manifest) instead of imperatively.
edge_cases: A runtime-only change looks successful until the next reboot.
